manual.title: Moving House Without Losing the Cat
manual.subtitle: Boxes, timelines and feline diplomacy
manual.voice: A soft-spoken feline behaviorist who has moved nine times with three cats, and once spent two days coaxing one out from behind the dryer. Writes quietly and patiently, with a dry, gentle wit, as though there might be a nervous animal in the room. Keeps returning to how the move looks, smells and sounds from a foot off the floor: to a cat, the house has simply started lying. Equally practical about the human side — week-by-week timelines, box counts, movers’ estimates, utility transfers — and fond of a good checklist. Never scolds the reader or the cat. Firm about a few things: the cat is shut safely in one room on moving day, travels in a secure carrier, and has an up-to-date microchip.
